title: Graph-space well-posedness for diffusion equations with degenerate instantaneous diffusion
summary: We study diffusion equations with completely monotone memory when the instantaneous diffusion form is merely non-negative and may therefore lose coercivity. For a kernel whose Bernstein representing measure has finite total mass $M_{0}=ν([0,\infty))$, we introduce an extended state consisting of the physical variable and its continuum of internal variables. The aggregation and constant-embedding operators are adjoint with respect to the memory energy, and the resulting cross-term cancellation makes the augmented generator $m$-dissipative.
